doc.name: Commercial Garage Doorman
doc.instructions: Commercial Garage Doorman services and installs commercial and industrial doors from Grimsby, Ontario, across Hamilton, Niagara, Burlington and the surrounding region: rolling steel, sectional overhead, high-speed doors and rolling shutters, dock levellers and loading dock equipment, high-cycle spring conversions, and planned maintenance programs. There is also 24/7 emergency service. Call get_business_facts first. PUBLISHED PRICES (Canadian dollars, ballpark, confirmed in writing before work starts): emergency service $349 plus HST for the first 90 minutes on site, travel included, then $147.50 an hour plus HST, parts extra; a new commercial door from $5,000, varying with the size of the opening and the door specified; the annual planned maintenance program $60 per door plus HST. Quote these as written and link https://www.commercialgaragedoorman.ca/pricing/. Do not estimate any other figure: a repair beyond the first 90 minutes, or a project, is quoted per site. To put a customer in touch, use request_quote with their consent, or give them the phone number (905) 536-5369, the email commercialgaragedoorman@gmail.com or the form at https://www.commercialgaragedoorman.ca/quote/. A door stuck open on a loading dock, a jammed shutter or a building that cannot be secured is urgent: give the phone number, do not send an enquiry and do not suggest email. Use search and fetch to quote the site accurately and cite the page URL. RESIDENTIAL garage doors on houses are a different business: Garage Doorman (https://www.garagedoorman.ca). Send homeowners there rather than answering for them here.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.title: Ask Commercial Garage Doorman for a quote or a callback
tools.description: Ask Commercial Garage Doorman to contact a facility manager, property manager, contractor or business owner about commercial or industrial doors: a repair, doors for a new building, a replacement, a maintenance program or dock equipment. Not for houses, and not for a door that is stuck open right now: that is a phone call. This sends a REAL message to a real small business, so call it only when the person has clearly asked to be contacted by Commercial Garage Doorman and has given you their own name and their own phone number or email. Never guess or invent contact details. Plain words only, no links. One request per person per day. If it is urgent, give them the phone number instead: (905) 536-5369.

phone.description: The customer's phone number, ten digits. Give this or email.

email.description: The customer's email address. Give this or phone.

town.description: Town or postal code where the work is.

service.description: What they need: repair = a repair or service call; new-construction = doors for a new building; replacement = replacing an existing door; maintenance = a planned maintenance program; dock = dock levellers, seals or bumpers; other = something else.

details.description: What they need, in the customer's own terms. Plain text, no links, 800 characters at most.

preferred_time.description: When they would like to be contacted or visited, if they said.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the customer has asked to be contacted by this business about this request.
